sort_method.description: The sorting mechanism to use for file lists. Valid values include: atime, basename, ctime, extension, mtime, natural, type, size, random.

show_hidden.description: Whether to show hidden files (files starting with a dot) in the file list.

use_preview_script.description: Whether to use an external script (preview_script) for generating file previews.

colorscheme.description: The name of the colorscheme to use. Built-in options include default, jungle, snow.

default_linemode.description: The default linemode for displaying files. Options include filename, fileinfo, mtime, humanreadablemtime, sizemtime, humanreadablesizemtime, permissions, metatitle.
